shows.blurb: After a pandemic sweeps the planet, a woman grapples with grief, rage, and loss as a mysterious illness disintegrates her reality.

shows.title: A Horror Musical
shows.blurb: Join Spontaneity’s ‘Improv the Musical’ for their opening AND closing night. Inspired by horror-comedy musicals, every show is a one night only creation packed with screams, laughs, eerie songs, and twists nobody will see coming, not even the improvisers!

shows.title: A Life in 60 Minutes
shows.blurb: A Life In 60 Minutes is a one-man spoken word theatre performance by Dwayne Morgan, exploring fatherhood, immigrant family life, aging parents, and growing up Black — told with humour, honesty, and unforgettable poetry.

shows.title: A Night to Remember
shows.blurb: Iris has pictured this evening for awhile. Unfortunately... so has her long term boyfriend, Caleb. A candlelit dinner filled with confessions, conflict and champagne. It certainly will be A Night to Remember.

shows.title: Abagenzi b’Ingoma

shows.title: Actual Wizard TONIGHT
shows.blurb: As seen on Penn & Teller: Fool Us, and winner of the Audience Choice Best of the Fest Award at the 2025 Halifax Fringe. Actual Wizard and Halifax Magician Vincenzo Ravina returns to Neptune Theatre with his seventh weird magic show: Actual Wizard TONIGHT

shows.title: Ape Breton
shows.blurb: Five years after Cape Breton has been seized by evil apes, the last free human survivors on the island need to know: what is Big Ape hiding under armed guard in the Forbidden-est Zone?

shows.title: Ape Play
shows.blurb: Diane is an ape who thinks she’s above it all. Living in the forests of Indonesia, she toils at her typewriter, desperate to create a work of art that’ll cement her legacy in a human library!

shows.title: APPLES! as told by an expert
shows.blurb: Do you have a favourite apple? Do you like apples? Do you appreciate your local food growers? Join Comedian and Apple Expert August Van Meekeren in this comedy show all about Nova Scotia’s Apples.

shows.title: Becoming Psychic
shows.blurb: A skeptic begins having psychic experiences and is forced to confront a terrifying possibility: she might be losing her mind. Becoming Psychic is a darkly funny solo show about doubt, belief, and the cultural line between insight and insanity.

shows.title: Bird Watch
shows.blurb: Join two curious birdwatchers on a fun-filled aerial-circus adventure across Nova Scotia as they meet their feathered friends: the playful Atlantic Puffin, the majestic Bald Eagle, the fiery Red Cardinal, and the colourful Blue Jay, a true free spirit.

shows.title: Cecily Cardew Deserves Better

shows.title: chronology of a genocide
shows.blurb: chronology of a genocide is a poetry reading, chronologically bearing witness to the escalation of the genocide in Gaza, Palestine since October 2023.

shows.title: Craig in Conversation with God
shows.blurb: The world is ending. The meteor is dropping. And the only one who can save us... is Craig. Every day is the same for Craig the dinosaur until he is visited by a presence from above.

shows.title: Drag me to the Opera

shows.title: Everyone is Interesting
shows.blurb: Everyone is Interesting is a community-focused project that aims to explore, engage with, and unite the individuals who call Kjipuktuk/Halifax home. Inspired by Mammalian Diving Reflex’s internationally acclaimed ‘social acupuncture,’ audiences will embark

shows.title: Game of drones... Drummers Are Coming
shows.blurb: Hear massed bagpipes, driving snares, and booming bass as classic pipe tunes meet pop-culture swagger in a tight, pulse- raising set by the Edmonton Police Service.

shows.title: IAGO vs HAMLET
shows.blurb: Two of Shakespeares most famous guys accidentally rented the same rehearsal space, what follows is a FIVE STAR, SOLD OUT comedy that ends with a showdown for the ages.

shows.title: Improv Party
shows.blurb: Mario Party crossover with Improv? Welcome to Improv Party! Imagine Mario Party, except the boards are custom made Halifax local landmarks, and the minigames are improvisors trying their hardest to act funny in order to impress their hosts.

shows.title: In Search of Black People
shows.blurb: Roz Browne searches for her “tribe” and connections as she journeys through life. Boston native talks about moving to a mostly all white neighborhood, being bussed to an all white school in the suburbs, and more.

shows.title: Jon Bennett: AMERICAN'T

shows.title: Jon Pickett fresh off the lot: stories of a used car salesmen
shows.blurb: A comedy show that tells the story of my emotional journey through a 10 year car sales career.

shows.title: Kimiko
shows.blurb: What happens to a community when thousands are imprisoned because of their race? Kimiko explores this question through a powerful blend of circus, storytelling, and traditional Japanese arts. This award-winning performance traces the generational impact of

shows.title: Loony Lundi
shows.blurb: River and their mother can’t seem to understand each other. But thanks to an unconventional therapy — maybe they can. This is a fast-paced comedy about queer adulthood, the sacrifices of parenting, and the fine line between trying and actually getting it.

shows.title: Lou Reed’s Magic and Loss: an interactive show about grief and death
shows.blurb: Lou Reed’s Magic and Loss emerged at the height of the AIDS crisis in the early 1990s. It hit hard, shining a light on death, memory, and grieving in inner city New York.

shows.title: LUMBER
shows.blurb: Join Jack around the fire as he tells his story of finding community in unlikely places and connecting with his home and heritage in an unconventional way.

shows.title: Making It!
shows.blurb: Success. The Oxford Dictionary calls it, “The accomplishment of an aim or purpose.” Taylor Swift calls it, “Doing what I love, being happy, and making good money.” Megan calls it, “Using all the broccoli up in the fridge before it goes bad.”

shows.title: Men Love Horsies: The Musical
shows.blurb: Just a man singing songs about horses. Men Love Horsies: The Musical won Best In Fringe, Critic’s Pick, and Best In Series at the Hamilton Fringe Festival and was selected to showcase at The San Francisco Sketchfest and Toronto Sketchfest.

shows.title: Metal Box
shows.blurb: A true story of Wendy Martin’s adventures hitchhiking across the East Coast of Canada and all the way to Paisley Park, the home of musician Prince, in Minnesota.

shows.title: Nova Scotia Business Inc.: a decolonial satire
shows.blurb: When two hikers somehow wander 75 years forward in time on their way home, they’re shocked to find a dystopian future Halifax where everything — and nothing — has changed. But when they stumble into a secret underground community of artists and land defend

shows.title: Ocean Kin: A Shadow Show
shows.blurb: Ocean Kin is a poetic shadow show contemplating our relationship to body and self inspired by the ecology of the sea otter. Three performers animate plexi-glass puppets, 3D sculptural props and projected illustrations onto a screen using flashlights and an

shows.title: On Guard For Thee
shows.blurb: The country is nearing its end. The four horsemen of the apocalypse appear, looking nothing like you'd expect. Final Snowfall Theatre Collective presents "On Guard for Thee", an original script by Kian Diab.

shows.title: Passed Down
shows.blurb: Persephone inherits her Great Aunt Lizzie’s Victorian-style home upon her passing. On her first evening in the house she learns that she may have inherited more than just the house.

shows.title: Peak Twins
shows.blurb: Having successfully (ish) solved last year’s mystery, FBI agents Fulder and Dully find themselves in the bizarre, non-trademarked town of Peak Twins. This sequel to the 2025 fringe hit The Y Files features a cast of local performers in a damn fine venue.

shows.title: Polarity
shows.blurb: In today’s hustle and bustle, do you feel alone? Unmoored? Unsure which lunch, car, partner, or life path to choose? For millenia, the enlightened stars have been hanging brightly, yearning for our attention! So lock your phones, turn your eyes to the sky,

shows.title: Putt Putt Punishment
shows.blurb: Get ready for the craziest one-man clown show ever! Putt Putt Punishment is the whacky and heartfelt story about Ehja the Clown, and his golfing quest to make Papa proud by winning the prestigious Putt Putt Trophy.

shows.title: Seen Worse
shows.blurb: Seen Worse is a stand-up comedy show from Karim, a Lebanese comedian now living in Canada, sharing funny and relatable stories about starting over in a new country.

shows.title: So... What ELSE About Love?
shows.blurb: Three friends, Kelin, Carrie and Phil, hitting midlife, navigate the realities of 21st century living, recognizing that their salvation may lie in the joy and spirit of resistance they find in making art together.

shows.title: Steven Goes to Japan to Run a Marathon
shows.blurb: Witness the story of a barely average man’s experience at running the dreaded marathon…In Japan! Steven Andrews tells a tale of perseverance, rice balls, Japanese toilets, a failing body, Nintendo, and the importance of embracing a different culture.

shows.title: Terrible Fish
shows.blurb: Terrible Fish is a one-woman show about the gut punch of mid-life. Caitlin Murphy, tackles topics like female rage, ambivalent motherhood, domestic ennui, beauty standards, and, of course, the dreaded dating apps.

shows.title: The Anytime Hour
shows.blurb: Anything is possible and anyone is welcome, so come join Shwing Entertainment, live! From singing and dancing to films and sketches! Expect the unexpected and still be surprised!

shows.title: The Atomic Priesthood
shows.blurb: 10,000 years in the future, a fringe religious group pleads to their gods for help with a fast spreading plague. Unbeknownst to them, the disease is far more complicated than they could have ever imagined.

shows.title: The Cult of the Comfy Wizard
shows.blurb: In today’s dark times find comfort with The Cult of the Comfy Wizard. Discover a world of rituals, past lives, and ancestral memories. Witness the rise and fall of a misguided guru.

shows.title: The Defenestration of Prague
shows.blurb: May 23rd, 1618, several aristocrats were tossed out of the Prague Imperial Palace by The Defenders, a ragtag group of Czech nobles. A Shakespearean comedy for ages 14+.

shows.title: The Fabulist
shows.blurb: THE FABULIST traces the midpoint in the life of an important trail-blazing folklorist. Helen Creighton has devoted her life to collecting and preserving the songs of her beloved native Maritime Canada. Unfortunately (or is it?), the songs are equaled only

shows.title: the in-between
shows.blurb: Snail is a poet snail. Or rather, a snail poet. They were born in a metal bin by a library, cushioned by tossed away sheets of Virginia Woolf’s Orlando. They have ventured far and wide in order to be here, in this garden.

shows.title: The Jackson Elementary Gr 6 Drama Club presents: BLOOD & SNOW: THE DONNER PARTY’S FATAL FORAY INTO THE SIERRA NEVADA WILDERNESS
shows.blurb: Welcome to Jackson Elementary, where Mrs Hazel’s Grade 6 class is about to unveil the skit they’ve devised for Pioneer Week. What ensues is a pitch-black, fairly-historically-accurate tragicomedy about America’s most notorious overlanders: the Donner Party

shows.title: The Trouble with My Hair: Coloring, Cutting, and Coming into Who I AM
shows.blurb: A Canada and Halifax Fringe premiere, The Trouble with My Hair examines gender, sexual, and racial identity through Cheng’s evolving relationship with her hair—and the stylists who helped shape it.

shows.title: The Ward and The Watershed
shows.blurb: The Ward and The Watershed takes place in a prison, on an island, in an ocean, on a planet, not so different from our own. This prison is built around a spring of fresh water which is controlled by The Warden.

shows.title: There is No Anger Like That Of A Woman
shows.blurb: When a banker walks into a brothel and pays for an hour with the most expensive woman, what he gets is not what either of them expected. There Is No Anger Like That of a Woman is a show about desire, power, and a woman playing an unbeatable game.

shows.title: Things That Go Bump
shows.blurb: Enter the parlour of a forgotten age, where the veil between worlds grows thin. If the spirits are willing, your mysterious hostess will share strange phenomena, unsettling revelations, and moments that challenge your senses.

shows.title: WHITE SAMOSA
shows.blurb: White Samosa is a spicy stand-up special from Vancouver’s first multilingual comedian, Harmeet Singh Kohli. Armed with accents and unapologetic punchlines, Harmeet takes aim at cultural appropriation, Uber-driving stereotypes, and everything in between.

shows.title: Whose Presentation Is It Anyway?
shows.blurb: Imagine a convention or conference where all the speakers have gotten sick and random audience members have to step up, improvising their way through each slide. That a good indication of what you’ll experience at Whose Presentation Is It Anyway?
